steps.title: HCL Workspace & Provider Configuration
steps.description: Initialize a professional Terraform workspace with provider constraints and local execution directories.
tasks: Create `main.tf` with initial comments and provider declarations

verification.command: test -d /home/student/terraform-lab && test -f /home/student/terraform-lab/versions.tf && grep -q 'required_version' /home/student/terraform-lab/versions.tf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Declarative Resources & Variable Interpolation
steps.description: Write declarative HCL resources defining configuration assets with dynamic variables and local file providers.

verification.command: grep -q 'local_file' /home/student/terraform-lab/main.tf && grep -q 'var.environment' /home/student/terraform-lab/main.tf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Typed Variables & Secure Outputs
steps.description: Structure input variables with type constraints, default values, descriptions, and create calculated output values.

verification.command: test -f /home/student/terraform-lab/variables.tf && test -f /home/student/terraform-lab/outputs.tf && grep -q 'variable "environment"' /home/student/terraform-lab/variables.tf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Modular Architecture (Child Module Design)
steps.description: Decompose flat monolithic HCL into clean, reusable child modules (`modules/networking` and `modules/compute`).

verification.command: test -d /home/student/terraform-lab/modules/networking && grep -q 'module "network"' /home/student/terraform-lab/main.tf && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Remote State Backend & Locking Simulation
steps.description: Configure S3/GCS remote backend architecture with DynamoDB state locking to prevent concurrent state corruption.
tasks: Define `terraform { backend "s3" { bucket = "opsacademy-tf-state" key = "prod/app.tfstate" region = "us-east-1" dynamodb_table = "terraform-locks" encrypt = true } }`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/terraform-lab/backend.tf && grep -q 'backend "s3"' /home/student/terraform-lab/backend.tf && grep -q 'dynamodb_table' /home/student/terraform-lab/backend.tf && echo PASS || echo FAIL
